recon.notes: Wix site; platform confirmed by the working wix-warmup-data payload carrying appDefinitionId 140603ad-af8d-84a5-2c80-a0f60cb47351 (Wix Events) and by the /event-details/<slug> pages' JSON-LD, not by CSS. CHUNK is a touring party (Chicago, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Portland, Brooklyn), so city/timezone/bar/address/location are set per event from location.fullAddress + geocode and no city default is used. TIMEZONE TRAP: the warmup rows store UTC instants (Chicago 9/19 9 PM = "2026-09-20T02:00:00.000Z"; Folsom 9/26 10 PM = "2026-09-27T05:00:00.000Z"; LA 10/17 11 PM = "2026-10-18T06:00:00.000Z"); every row also carries timeZoneId and a scheduling.formatted local string, and every event page's JSON-LD carries the offset form. Dates here are the LOCAL wall clock. Config-blocked pages /chunk and /chunkbearandcubsocial were opened: both are shop pages ('new arrivals'), zero events, so blocking them costs nothing and no out-of-config-scope trap is needed. The homepage image set minus the 15 event mainImages is the logo ('CHUNK EST. 2007'), a headshot, and three 201x201 Wix social icons — no flyer-only events. The 12 past rows and the cancelled Portland page are counted in coverage.basis, not enumerated. Run 20260909-072307 returned 14 CHUNK events (the 3 upcoming + 11 past; NYE 2025 and the cancelled Portland page absent); its 'CHUNK Brooklyn' 7/4 record carries startDate 2026-07-04T04:00:00.000Z where the site's row says 2026-07-05T02:00:00.000Z — a diff-pass observation, not recorded here.

coverage.basis: Feed door (homepage wix-warmup-data, widgetTPASection_me4z3wpj.events): 15 rows, hasMore false, of which 3 have status 0 (upcoming) and 12 have status 2 (past) — the feed's own flag says there is nothing to page. Second door (event-pages-sitemap.xml): 16 URLs = those 15 slugs + chunk-portland-the-return-new-date-cancelled; the delta is one cancelled duplicate of the March 14 Portland row whose JSON-LD says EventCancelled and which the widget drops, so both doors agree on 3 upcoming events. Third door: all 16 event pages were fetched and their JSON-LD dates match their widget rows one for one; the three upcoming pages were read in full for date, venue, address and ticket tiers. Every row has recurrences.occurrences [] so 3 rows = 3 dated singles, no series. Past listings: 12 past widget rows (each with its own event page) plus the 1 sitemap-only cancelled page = 13 past pages, counted here, not enumerated. The three flyers were opened and corroborate day, month, lineup and venue (no year printed on any flyer; the year comes from the warmup JSON and JSON-LD).

traps.label: 12 past cards under 'Upcoming Events' with a 'Details' button (Sat, Sep 05 ... Wed, Dec 31)
traps.why: The Wix Events widget lists past events after the upcoming ones under the same 'Upcoming Events' heading; their warmup rows carry status 2 and each has a live /event-details/ page with EventScheduled JSON-LD. They are real but finished events, kept only under allowPastEvents. The listing cards print no year ('Wed, Dec 31' is 2025-12-31 per its JSON-LD "startDate":"2025-12-31T21:00:00-06:00"), so a text-only reader would carry the wrong year.

expect.note: Extraction is correct behaviour under allowPastEvents; run 20260909-072307 returned 11 of the 12 (NYE 2025 absent).
